items.d: Nvidia shares have tumbled by more than 10% since Monday, erasing almost $500 billion in market value.
items.fullText: Corporations Nvidia hires former acting U.S. attorney to probe Jensen Huang affair Nvidia shares have tumbled by more than 10% since Monday, erasing almost $500 billion in market value. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia names outside council for investigation into CEO’s affair 02:00 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 10, 2026, 3:51 PM EST / Updated Nov. 10, 2026, 4:18 PM EST By Steve Kopack Nvidia’s board of directors announced Tuesday that it had hired a prominent former prosecutor and a top Wall Street law firm to probe the events surrounding CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China. “The independent members of the NVIDIA Board have retained former acting U.S. Attorney of the Southern District of New York Joon H. Kim and his firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct a thorough and independent investigation as was announced on Sunday,” the company said in a statement. The announcement followed revelations over the weekend that included Huang’s admission of an extramarital affair. U.S. intelligence agencies believe that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and business executive, spied for Beijing, sources told NBC News. Nvidia loses $200B in value amid alleged Chinese spy scandal 02:20 The hiring of Kim and his law firm raises the stakes significantly for Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993. Many of Nvidia’s board members have worked alongside Huang for decades and become wealthier with him. But Tuesday’s announcement signaled that Nvidia’s board does not intend its probe to serve as a rubber stamp for Huang’s actions. Wachtell Lipton is one of the nation’s most influential law firms, and its attorneys have track records of taking on corporate titans. As Wall Street’s top cop, Kim battled mob bosses and billion-dollar hedge funds in the U.S. attorney’s office. Alice Huang with Jensen Huang in Taipei, Taiwan, in 2024. NetThunder/LinkedIn As of Tuesday, Jensen Huang remained in his post as Nvidia’s CEO, and a spokesperson for the company told NBC News over the weekend that he was focused on leading the trillion-dollar AI chip giant “without interruption.” President Donald Trump said Monday that the FBI was also probing the events. items.t: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
items.d: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAIs Sam Altman or SpaceXAIs Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in an affair that could have ramifications beyond Huangs personal life and potentially impact national security. United States officials believe that Huangs likely romantic interest, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company, had reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each countrys economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the worlds largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. November 9, 2026: Huang pulls out of various speaking engagements The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum. November 9-10, 2026: Details emerge about the business relationships between Nvidia and the alleged spy Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. Founded in 2023, it became an Nvidia-preferred cloud partner, giving it priority access to chips, The Information reported . The Information also reported that Shanghai Century Litong facilitated buying $7.5 billion worth of Nvidias chips, including banned chips. Nvidias head lawyer, Tim Teter, intervened in a 2025 U.S. government probe surrounding the suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International, Bloomberg reported . Teter contacted Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler asking questions about whether the Trump administration played a role in detaining Alice Huang. In early 2025, Alice Huang and a business partner sought China-based investors for an Asian data center, promising they had no problem in securing GPUs, the Financial Times reported. November 8, 2026: Trump shows support for Nvidia CEO, calls him a fine person On Sunday night, President Trump weighed in on Huangs controversy and showed support for the Nvidia CEO. items.t: Nvidia shares sink while stock market surges
items.d: Nvidia announced it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia shares sink while stock market surges The tech giant opened a probe into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia announces investigation into CEO over ties to alleged Chinese spy 02:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 9, 2026, 10:56 AM EST / Updated Nov. 9, 2026, 4:19 PM EST By Steve Kopack and Rob Wile It was a great day for stocks. Just not Nvidia’s. The company’s shares slid 4.2% on Monday after it announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman who U.S. intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. Despite Nvidia’s importance to the AI trade, the news affected almost no other stocks. The Nasdaq 100, which tracks the top tech stocks at the Nasdaq exchange, soared 3.4%. The broader S&P 500 rose 2.3%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose more than 1,100 points. Stocks were also propelled higher by a more than 4% drop in oil prices Monday on news that U.S.--Iran talks were continuing. Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow and the S&P 500. The investigation has the potential to unsettle the entire AI boom, fueled by trillions of dollars of spending and investments, in part to purchase Nvidia’s cutting-edge AI chips. Nvidia’s drop wiped out almost $200 billion in value. Huang, who founded the company more than three decades ago, admitted in a note to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife. “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” Huang’s email also said. In recent days, the Financial Times and The New York Times reported that Huang had a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang. A person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News that U.S. intelligence agencies had determined that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. The two Huangs are unrelated. items.t: 포스트 젠슨 황이 없다…외도 스캔들에 휘청이는 ‘1인 제국’ 엔비디아
items.fullText: 본문 경제 글로벌워치 포스트 젠슨 황이 없다…외도 스캔들에 휘청이는 ‘1인 제국’ 엔비디아 이완 기자 수정 2026-11-11 00:34 펼침 0:00 Your browser does not support the audio element. 임원 50명이 젠슨 황에게 직보 절대적 의존, 위기에 취약성 드러내 2025년 5월 대만 타이베이의 한 식당에서 열린 만찬에 참석한 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO·오른쪽 검은 옷)와 중국 스파이 의혹을 받는 앨리스 황(가운데). AFP 연합뉴스 광고 젠슨 황(63) 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 스캔들은 전세계 빅테크(거대기술기업)의 주가를 흔들었을 뿐 아니라 엔비디아 내 그를 대체할 후계자가 없다는 사실을 고스란히 드러냈다. 엔비디아가 전세계 인공지능 산업에 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 등 핵심 인프라뿐만 아니라 엄청난 자금을 뿌려 투자를 뒷받침하는 데는 젠슨 황의 ‘스타성’이 큰 역할을 하고 있었는데, 이 같은 구조가 지속가능할지 신뢰에 흠이 간 것이다. 젠슨 황은 지난 1993년 엔비디아를 창업한 이후 33년간 뒤로 물러선 적 없이 회사를 이끌어왔다. 미국 증권거래위원회에 지난 5월 공시된 엔비디아의 신고서와 엔비디아 누리집을 보면, 엔비디아 이사회는 현재 11명으로 구성돼 있다. 젠슨 황을 제외하고는 모두 사외이사(독립이사)이다. 이사회엔 의장이 따로 없고 사외이사들이 매해 수석이사를 지명하며, 수석이사가 젠슨 황이 참석하지 않는 분기별 회의를 여는 등 최고경영자를 견제하는 역할을 하고 있다. 하지만 사외이사인 텐치 콕과 하비 존스 등은 회사 설립 때부터 이사를 맡는 등 이사회 면면 역시 젠슨 황과 인연이 깊은 인사들로 채워져 있다. 외신은 젠슨 황이 이사회를 형식적 요건으로 간주해왔다고 전한다. 경영진 구성도 젠슨 황만을 정점에 두고 있다. 젠슨 황 외에 최고경영진은 최고재무책임자(CFO) 콜렛 크레스, 전세계 운영담당 닉 파커, 운영담당 데보라 쇼퀴스트 등 4명이며, 별도의 단독 사장이나 최고운영책임자 등을 두고 있지 않다. 이를 두고 젠슨 황은 자신에게 직접 보고하는 사람이 50명이라며 “기업의 가치에서 가장 중요한 것은 정보의 속도”라고 강조하고 엔비디아를 리더십을 하나로 둔 수평적 조직이라고 설명했다. 광고 이 때문에 역설적으로 엔비디아의 위험요인은 젠슨 황에 대한 의존도가 너무 크다는 점이 지적된다. 엔비디아의 연례보고서(Form 10-K)를 보면 “회사의 미래 성공은 특히 사장 겸 최고경영자인 젠슨 황과 고위 경영진의 기여에 달려있다”면서 경영 승계 계획이 없는 게 사업에 부정적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 지적하고 있다. 뉴욕타임스는 이런 상황에서 젠슨 황의 자녀인 스펜서 황과 메디슨 황, 사위인 니코 카프레즈 등의 역할이 급부상한 것도 사내 구성원의 불만 요인이 됐다고 전했다. 한편 엔비디아의 주가는 9일(현지시각) 뉴욕 증시에서 전 거래일보다 4.3% 내린 178.67달러에 장을 마쳤다. 장중 한때 8.8% 급락하기도 했다. 국제 유가 급락에 따라 이날 뉴욕 증시가 반등한 것과 대조를 이뤘다. 엔비디아 주가는 1주일 전과 비교해 11.6% 떨어졌고, 시가총액은 5640억달러 줄었다. 광고 광고 이완 기자 wani@hani.co.kr
